method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stock futures rise as investors await Nvidia earnings, inflation report due later this week
Equities.reason: Market narrative dominated by anticipation of Nvidia earnings and macro data — supports short-term risk-on into AI leadership while investors await earnings/inflation catalysts.

Equities.title: Nvidia shares set for $280 billion price swing after earnings, options show
Equities.reason: Very large implied move in Nvidia creates elevated volatility risk for the market given its leadership weighting in indexes and ETFs; increases downside tail risk if results disappoint.

Equities.title: Tech Leads US Stocks Lower as Nvidia Earnings, Jackson Hole Loom
Equities.reason: Reports of tech-led weakness ahead of key Nvidia earnings/Jackson Hole underscore a risk-off impulse concentrated in mega-cap AI/semiconductor names that can drag broad indices.

Equities.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq end down on tech stocks, investors weigh Iran moves
Equities.reason: Combined tech weakness and fresh geopolitical/Iran-sanctions headlines are pressuring broad US equity sentiment — larger negative because it mixes sector concentration risk with geopolitical uncertainty.

Equities.title: U.S. to unveil 'greatest financial offensive' against Iran as Tehran threatens ship seizures
Equities.summary: The escalation came as both sides have missed a 60-day ceasefire window to reach a deal, closing off the formal truce mechanism to end the six-month war.
Equities.reason: Major sanctions/war escalation increases macro risk premium, raises energy/commodity uncertainty and dents investor risk appetite across equities — meaningful market-wide negative.

Equities.title: Trump says U.S. will hike Canada auto tariffs to 50% as trade war escalates
Equities.summary: President Donald Trump said the U.S. will raise tariffs on imports of cars, trucks and auto parts from Canada to 50% on Jan. 1, 2027.
Equities.reason: Escalating US-Canada trade tensions increase policy uncertainty and pose sectoral downside to autos, parts and cross-border supply chains — negative for cyclical/economic-sensitive equities.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: Waiting on Nvidia for next leg of AI rally
Equities.reason: Reuters frames Nvidia as the key to the next AI-driven equity leg higher — a strong positive narrative supporting concentrated risk-on positioning if results validate the AI growth thesis.

Equities.title: Nvidia employee charged with smuggling advanced chips into China
Equities.summary: Prosecutors identify Taiwan-based manager as ‘central figure’ in scheme involving US semiconductor maker’s AI servers
Equities.reason: Enforcement/export-control headlines against chip supply chains add a regulatory/supply risk layer to semiconductor and AI hardware stocks — modestly negative for the sector and market sentiment.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall as Chip Rout Overshadows Drop in Oil: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Chip-focused selling is a dominant market impulse that can propagate to index performance given sector concentration; represents a clear risk-off impulse centered on semiconductors/AI names.

Equities.title: S.E.C. Investigating Near-Implosion of A.I. Hedge Fund
Equities.reason: Probe into a leveraged AI hedge fund raises concerns about crowded, levered positioning in AI strategies — a modest negative for risk appetite and potential for contagion in volatile episodes.

Equities.title: Broadcom Credit Risk Soars on Mega AI Debt Financing Backstops
Equities.reason: Credit pressure around a major AI supplier signals stress in financing for large AI deals — negative for investor sentiment toward hardware/software vendors underpinning the AI rally.

Equities.title: Asia shares fall on tech nerves; oil prices slip
Equities.reason: Asia equity weakness driven by tech-sector nerves reinforces a broader risk-off tone across global equities tied to semiconductor/AI uncertainties.

Rates.title: Treasury yields steady as traders await more economic data
Rates.summary: Treasury yields steadied on Tuesday as investors await more data releases for insights into the U.S. economic picture.
Rates.reason: Headline describes a neutral short-term market state (yields steady) while awaiting data — little immediate directional signal for rates.

Rates.title: Bessent could tap near $1 trillion Treasury General Account to fund bond buybacks, sources said
Rates.summary: Using the TGA would provide the Treasury with considerable firepower to influence long-term bond yields.
Rates.reason: Large potential TGA-funded buyback capacity is a material, explicit tool to push Treasury yields lower; significant market-wide implication for rates (positive for bonds).

Rates.title: Prediction market traders doubtful Bessent’s bond interventions will push yields lower
Rates.summary: Speculators still see yields hitting new highs in 2026 and ending the year at levels elevated from where they're currently trading.
Rates.reason: Market participants expressing skepticism that buybacks will materially lower yields reinforces a higher-for-longer yields narrative (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Bessent says Treasury auctions will continue as usual despite expanded buyback program
Rates.reason: Confirmation that auctions continue despite buybacks implies ongoing supply alongside repurchase activity — reduces the net easing impact of buybacks on yields (mildly negative for bonds).

Rates.title: What’s Behind the U.S. Treasury’s Latest Attempt to Lower Interest Rates
Rates.reason: Explains the Treasury's intentional policy to influence longer-term rates via buybacks — a coherent, policy-driven attempt to lower yields (positive for bonds).

Rates.title: Bessent's $4 billion bond buyback wanted lower yields. It got a bitcoin surge instead.
Rates.reason: Coverage that early buybacks failed to push yields lower (and generated other asset moves) supports market skepticism about the effectiveness of interventions (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Bessent’s Mentor Druckenmiller Calls Bond Buying a Mistake
Rates.reason: Prominent market voice calling the buyback program a mistake feeds the narrative that interventions may not sustainably lower yields — negative signal for bond prices.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, July 28–29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, July 28–29, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a high‑impact source for policy direction; given ongoing market context (higher-for-longer pricing and skepticism of external yield suppression), the minutes are treated as a material potential driver keeping yields elevated (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Santoli: Why all the fuss about bond yields is happening now
Rates.summary: The textbooks say the cycle high in real yields should act as a restraint on economic growth and equity valuations.
Rates.reason: Commentary framing high real yields as an economic and market restraint supports the prevailing narrative of elevated yields (negative for bonds).

FX.title: United States Dollar Index holds gains near 99.00 amid escalating geopolitical risks
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending its gains for the second successive day and trading around 99.00 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Clear USD strength driven by escalating geopolitics/safe-haven flows; DXY near a key level implies broad FX impact and market-risk transmission.

FX.title: Dollar Gains as US Plan to Cut Off Iran Spurs Haven Demand
FX.reason: Major-news catalyst linking US policy action to safe-haven demand for USD — reinforces cross-market USD bid and broader FX risk-off regime.

FX.title: US Dollar: Data weakness keeps downside risks elevated - TD Securities
FX.summary: TD Securities strategists argue that the US Dollar (USD) has re-entered a bearish regime after the Treasury buyback announcement pushed the US Dollar Index (DXY) below its 200‑day SMA.
FX.reason: USD-bearish technical/liquidity argument (Treasury buyback, DXY below 200‑day SMA) — meaningful counter-signal but lower relevance versus strong geopolitical safe-haven flow.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar remains depressed as firmer USD and trade war counter higher oil prices
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair sticks to a positive bias for the second straight day and trades around mid-1.3800s during the Asian session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: USD firming versus CAD amid geopolitical/trade tensions — direct USD/CAD transmission and commodity/currency interplay relevant for FX flows.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: US Dollar keeps crawling towards the key 160.00 area

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Corrects further as US Dollar extends recovery

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar falls as US Dollar gains on safe-haven demand
FX.summary: NZD/USD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.5950 during the European hours on Tuesday. The currency pair faces downward pressure as the US Dollar (USD) gains strength from safe-haven demand driven by rising geopolitical tensions.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar gains as high inflation fuels odds of RBNZ September rate hikes
FX.summary: NZD/USD gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 0.5960 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Idiosyncratic NZD strength driven by local inflation/RBNZ rate expectations — a counter-signal to the USD-safe-haven theme but lower relevance to the dominant USD story.

FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening session on Tuesday.

FX.reason: EMFX pressure (IDR weakness) reflects external/USD strength and capital-flow stress — relevant to EM currency vulnerability vs USD.

This weakens the bullish narrative modestly (conditional/cross-asset nuance), so modest negative direction and low-medium relevance.

Commodities.reason: Near-term risk-off ahead of US PCE: headline-driven technical/forecast piece showing a corrective move in silver tied to macro data risk. Price-forecast/technical content -> capped relevance, clear short-term negative pressure.

Commodities.reason: Market momentum: Reuters reports gold at highest since mid-May with buying momentum — consistent with a broad bullish debasement/dollar-weakness narrative and U.S. Treasury move-driven flows. Significant market-moving tone -> elevated relevance and positive direction.

Commodities.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
Commodities.reason: Supply-side increase: technological/operational changes raising Permian production raise crude and gas supply prospects (negative for prices). Material fundamentals story for energy -> medium-high relevance and negative direction.

Commodities.title: Oil Steadies as US Plan Offers Little Clarity on Hormuz Deadlock
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical risk premium: headline signals unresolved Hormuz tensions and limited clarity from U.S. plans, which keeps a modest upside risk premium for oil. Small positive direction and medium-low relevance as the piece is about risk sentiment rather than supply shock.
